meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 写内部沟通稿时,Claude 先从示例文件里挑对应类型的模板,再按模板定格式、语气和要点;类型不明确会提问澄清。
howto.when: 当用户请 Claude 写内部沟通类内容(如 3P 更新、公司通讯、FAQ 回复)时触发;其他内部文稿走通用模板。

say.text: 帮我写一份给领导层的 3P 更新,列出本周进展、计划和问题。
say.note: 会按 3P 更新模板起草。

say.text: 起草一封公司全员通讯,宣布下季度目标。
把用户问得最多的几个问题整理成 FAQ 草稿。
say.note: 按 FAQ 回答模板生成。

howto.what_en: When drafting internal communications, Claude picks the matching template from the example files and follows its format, tone, and content requirements; if the type is unclear, it asks for clarification or more context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to write internal communications such as 3P updates, company newsletters, or FAQ replies; other internal messages go through a general template.

say_en.text: Help me write a 3P update for leadership: this week's progress, plans, and problems.
Draft a company-wide newsletter announcing next quarter's goals.
Turn the most common user questions into an FAQ draft.
